process: Computer control and monitoring at CWPB smelters (Sect. 5, Action 1)
measure: Computerised process control hardware and software on older CWPB smelters
reference: p.14, Sect. 5 (Installation of new emission reduction technologies)
note: Reduces anode effect frequency and duration. PRICE YEAR NOT STATED; publication year 1999 used. Minor power savings; life 20 years; total 13.8 Mt CO2e over BAU for the life of the investment. Cost basis not stated (installation).

process: Point breaker feeders on VSS and older SWPB smelters (Sect. 5, Action 2)
measure: Dense-phase alumina distribution and individual point feeders for each cell, plus process control
saving: 20-60 (CO2e from these smelters, varying with technology)
reference: p.15, Sect. 5 (Installation of Point Breaker Feeders)
note: PRICE YEAR NOT STATED; publication year 1999 used. Incremental retrofit cost. Net operating cost increase CA$5-10 per tonne of aluminium per year after offsetting manpower and energy savings; life 20 years with sustaining capital; 16.6 Mt CO2e saved over BAU; not fully proven on Soderberg cells.

process: HSS to CWPB replacement, advanced to 2000 (Sect. 5, Action 3)
measure: Premature shutdown of 226,000 t HSS capacity and replacement with CWPB
saving: 11.2 Mt CO2e over BAU; 0.8 Mt/yr by 2010
reference: p.16, Sect. 5 (Advancing the date for conversion from HSS to CWPB)
note: PRICE YEAR NOT STATED; publication year 1999 used. The summary (p.4) says no likely scenario in which industry would make the investment before plants reach end of life.
